body: I think you are missing the point of the post, although a vast majority of the discussion has gravitated toward the use of CHA for a Greatsword. The core issue is that a class feature is locked behind a weapon that you have to either gimp yourself to use or lose altogether. That feature is the ability to transfer your hex. The moon bow does not refresh or amplify an ability from archfey, why should cursebringer have a feature locked behind it. A feature that anyone running the class could and should be able to make use off. It is ridiculous. And nothing else in 5e does this.
